title: Implement Ticket Claim Queue with SKIP LOCKED
description: Implement the ticket claim queue using PostgreSQL SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for fair, non-blocking claim semantics. This replaces the git-push-based distributed lock. The claim queue allows agents to atomically claim the next available ticket matching their role criteria, without blocking other agents from claiming different tickets concurrently.
acceptance_criteria: Claim function atomically selects and locks the next available ticket using SKIP LOCKED
Claim filters by ticket type and agent role compatibility
Claims respect ticket dependencies (only READY tickets are claimable)
Concurrent claim attempts on the same ticket result in exactly one winner, others transparently skip
Claim creates a record in the claims table with agent_id, machine_id, and lease_expiry
Function returns the claimed ticket data or None if no eligible tickets exist
